question.prompt: Stratum A has 40 people and stratum B has 60 people. Stratified sampling is performed at a sampling fraction of \(1/10\). How many people should be sampled from stratum B?

solutions.explanation: Allocate the sample according to \(1/10\) of the number of people in each stratum. For stratum B, \(60\times 1/10=6\).
